name: isolated-three-model-http-admission-repair
rootCause: The isolated CLI supplied only the mdenseon builder, replacing the complete sidecar defaults. The model allowlist derives from supplied builder keys, so Harrier returned400 before model construction.
alternativeHypothesis: Harrier weights or worker runtime failed after the route accepted the request.

distinguishingObservation.before: Actual HTTP400 unknown model harrier expected only mdenseon; no first inferred response. A load/runtime failure would pass model admission and return an inference error.
distinguishingObservation.after: Shared isolatedEvaluationBuilders includes both maintained incumbent builders and candidate; driver checks scheduled model support. Same collector/request contract now receives actual native Harrier1024 response with one inferred text.

recurrenceGuard.test: admits all three model arms through the exact isolated CLI builder-map assembler
recurrenceGuard.syntheticScope: Unit and real HTTP tests inject vectors; they qualify route and collection guards, not real-model quality/performance.

typecheck.scope: Changed CLI, collector and integration test
